Introduction

MEGAMAX was a five-member boy group signed with InMedia Corp. Most of the members used to be part of the disbanded group Platinum78. The group includes Iden, Ha.El, HwanE, Jini and Kan.

They were originally set to officially debut on August 25, 2021, but were postponed due to COVID-19-related issues. They ultimately made their debut on September 8, 2021, with the mini album "Painted÷LOVE:)".

In July 2024, a former staff member announced that the group had quietly disbanded.
